sources.title: BamiBERT: A New BERT-based Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce BamiBERT, a new BERT-based pre-trained language model for Vietnamese that addresses key limitations of PhoBERT—the current de facto Vietnamese text encoder.

sources.title: BamiBERT: A New BERT-based Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: BamiBERT is a new Vietnamese BERT-based language model that surpasses PhoBERT by supporting 2048-token contexts and operating directly on raw text, achieving state-of-the-art results on 11 out of 15 benchmarks while simplifying deployment in real-world applications.
